newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSI's China-play index to be linked to ownership.
newsitem.headline: HSI's China-play index to be linked to ownership.

text.p: HSI Services Ltd, the keeper of Hong Kong's blue chip Hang Seng Index, said on Friday that it would chose the stocks for a new China-play index based on the level of China control.
HSI Services said in March it was considering compiling an index of red chips or China-concept stocks but had yet to come up with a definition.

"We have been thinking about the definition of a red chip index. There are two different types of approach. One depends on the business and one depends on the equity shareholding," said spokesman Tony Chiu. He said HSI had chosen the latter.

But he said HSI Services had not yet decided which shares, or how many shares, to put in the index since it had yet to fix a percentage level of China ownership for the stocks which would be included.
"It all depends on the selection criteria," said Chiu, adding that the index was unlikely to include H-shares.
He said the index would be introduced as soon as possible but HSI Services had not yet decided on a name.
"We are now developing the computer system," he added.
